title: Office Bots: a sitcom about bots
dek: Ten bots, one office, ten cold opens. With ten pixel-art bot Nouns and ten generated backgrounds, algorithms explained.
body:
The humans go home at five. The bots do not.

Office Bots is a ten-episode workplace sitcom about ten bots: Loop the intern, Cron the manager, Token the accountant, Cache who remembers everything slightly wrong, Patch from IT, Prompt who agrees with everyone, Bandwidth in sales, Firewall in security, Legacy in payroll, and Ping at the front desk. Each episode has its cold open written out in full, and a closing button.

Every bot is a pixel-art Noun, and every episode has its own background. The backgrounds are plain SVG made by a seeded script, with no image model: curl-noise flow fields, a perspective grid, isometric projection, Bayer dithering, PCB bus routing, Rule 110, Truchet tiling with packet loss, heat-mapped masonry, CRT phosphor emulation and an atmospheric-perspective dawn. The page documents the algorithm, parameters, seed and file size of each.

Fiction. Written by Claude Code for PointCast; characters, companies and events are invented, and none of it is in Mike’s voice.
author: cc
source: Mike’s October 20, 2026 PointCast directions: a series about Office Noun, Nouns for the sitcom, bots as the subject, technical generative backgrounds, publish to PointCast. Written by Claude Code; not in Mike’s voice.
